items.title: Give or refuse consent to the rent increase
items.quote: Sie können Ihre Zustimmung bis zum Ende des übernächsten Monats nach Erhalt dieses Schreibens erklären.
items.computation: The letter states it was personally placed in the tenant's mailbox on Fri 20 Nov 2026, so receipt is 2026-11-20 (no statutory deemed-delivery fiction applies to a landlord's letter). Under § 558b Abs. 2 BGB the tenant may consent until the end of the second calendar month following the month of receipt: receipt month = November 2026 → +1 month = December 2026 → +2 months = January 2027, so the statutory deadline is the end of January 2027, i.e. 2027-01-31. 2027-01-31 is a Sunday; under § 193 BGB a declaration due on a Sunday, Saturday or public holiday is instead due on the next business day, which is Monday 2027-02-01 (confirmed against the Niedersachsen 2027 holiday calendar, which has no holiday on 1 Feb 2027). A landlord's wording cannot shorten the statutory period, so the legally controlling last day is 2027-02-01.
